why: A better matches the warm, cream, light-wood palette the client asked for, with an oatmeal sofa, a beige rug and a light herringbone sideboard. B uses a stark white sofa, a cooler grey rug and a dark walnut sideboard. Both share the same weak point: six 56 cm armchairs won't fit around a 140 cm table, and the 70 cm coffee table is undersized. B does have the better reading lamp and better-scaled decor.
